```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(circlize)
  library(data.table)
})

# =========================
# Inputs
# =========================
in_csv   <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/IPM/functional_fusions_expression_only_IPM.BRCA_only.csv"
cyto_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/Reference_genome/Human/Human_ref_hg38_p7/cytoBand.txt"
out_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/IPM"
out_circos_pdf <- file.path(out_dir, "functional_fusions_expression_only_IPM.BRCA_only.circos.pdf")
out_circos_png <- file.path(out_dir, "functional_fusions_expression_only_IPM.BRCA_only.circos.png")
out_legend_pdf <- file.path(out_dir, "functional_fusions_expression_only_IPM.BRCA_only.legend.pdf")
out_legend_png <- file.path(out_dir, "functional_fusions_expression_only_IPM.BRCA_only.legend.png")
# out_table <- file.path(out_dir, "functional_fusions_expression_only_IPM.BRCA_only.arc_summary.csv")

# =========================
# Colors by expression status
# =========================
exp_colors <- c(
  "up-regulation"   = "#E64B35",
  "down-regulation" = "#4DBBD5"
)

# =========================
# Read + sanity
# =========================
dt <- fread(in_csv)
req <- c("chrA","StartA","chrB","StartB","exp")
missing_req <- setdiff(req, names(dt))
if (length(missing_req) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_req, collapse = ", "))
}

dt[, chrA := as.character(chrA)]
dt[, chrB := as.character(chrB)]
dt[, StartA := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(StartA))]
dt[, StartB := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(StartB))]
dt[, exp := as.character(exp)]

dt <- dt[!is.na(StartA) & !is.na(StartB)]
dt <- dt[nchar(chrA) > 0 & nchar(chrB) > 0]

std_chr <- c(paste0("chr", 1:22), "chrX", "chrY")
dt <- dt[chrA %in% std_chr & chrB %in% std_chr]

dt[, exp_clean := exp]
dt[!(exp_clean %in% names(exp_colors)) & !is.na(exp_clean), exp_clean := NA]

if (dt[is.na(exp_clean), .N] > 0) {
  bad_levels <- unique(dt[is.na(exp_clean), exp])
  message("WARNING: Found exp values not in exp_colors. These rows will be dropped.")
  message("Bad exp levels: ", paste(bad_levels, collapse = ", "))
  dt <- dt[!is.na(exp_clean)]
}

# =========================
# Collapse arcs
# =========================
dt_arc <- dt[, .(
  n_fusions = .N,
  exp_major = names(sort(table(exp_clean), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
), by = .(chrA, StartA, chrB, StartB)]

message("Total fusion rows in CSV: ", nrow(dt))
message("Unique arcs to plot: ", nrow(dt_arc))
message("Max fusions per arc: ", ifelse(nrow(dt_arc)>0, max(dt_arc$n_fusions), NA))

# =========================
# Quick table to inspect arcs
# =========================
message("\nTop arcs by fusion count:")
print(dt_arc[order(-n_fusions)][1:min(10, .N)])

# =========================
# Save arc summary table
# =========================
dt_arc_sorted <- dt_arc[order(-n_fusions)]
fwrite(dt_arc_sorted, out_table)
message("\nArc summary table saved to: ", out_table)

# =========================
# Chromosome lengths
# =========================
cyto <- fread(cyto_file, header = FALSE)
chr_len <- cyto[, .(chr_len = max(V3, na.rm = TRUE)), by = V1]
setnames(chr_len, "V1", "chr")

# =========================
# Add EndA and EndB columns
# =========================
dt_arc[, EndA := StartA + 1000]
dt_arc[, EndB := StartB + 1000]

# =========================
# Calculate line width based on fusion count
# Scale: 1 fusion = lwd 1, 2+ fusions = thicker
# =========================
dt_arc[, line_width := pmin(n_fusions, 5)]  # Cap at 5 to avoid overly thick lines

# =========================
# Prepare links for circos (EXACT format from original)
# =========================
links <- data.frame(
  chr1 = dt_arc$chrA,
  start1 = dt_arc$StartA,
  end1 = dt_arc$EndA,
  chr2 = dt_arc$chrB,
  start2 = dt_arc$StartB,
  end2 = dt_arc$EndB,
  n_fusions = dt_arc$n_fusions,
  line_width = dt_arc$line_width
)

# Add color based on expression
links$color <- exp_colors[dt_arc$exp_major]

# Valid chromosomes
valid_chroms <- std_chr

# =========================
# Plotting function with variable line width
# =========================
plot_fusion_circos <- function() {
  circos.clear()
  circos.par("track.height" = 0.05, cell.padding = c(0, 0, 0, 0), gap.degree = 1)
  
  circos.initializeWithIdeogram(
    species = "hg38", 
    chromosome.index = valid_chroms,
    labels.cex = 1.5,                    # Chromosome label size
  )
  
  if (nrow(links) > 0) {
    # Plot each link individually to control line width
    for (i in 1:nrow(links)) {
      circos.genomicLink(
        region1 = links[i, c("chr1", "start1", "end1"), drop = FALSE],
        region2 = links[i, c("chr2", "start2", "end2"), drop = FALSE],
        col = links$color[i],
        rou = 0.8,
        lwd = links$line_width[i]
      )
    }
  } else {
    warning("No fusions to plot.")
  }
}

# =========================
# Save circos plot to PNG (NO legend)
# =========================
png(out_circos_png, width = 2400, height = 2400, res = 300)
par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
plot_fusion_circos()
dev.off()

# =========================
# Save circos plot to PDF (NO legend)
# =========================
pdf(out_circos_pdf, width = 8, height = 8)
par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
plot_fusion_circos()
dev.off()

# =========================
# Save legend only to PNG 
# =========================
png(out_legend_png, width = 600, height = 400, res = 300)
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot.new()
legend("center",
       legend = c("Up-regulated Fusions", "Down-regulated Fusions"),
       col = c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5"),
       pch = 15,
       pt.cex = 1.2,
       cex = 0.9,
       title = "Fusion Expression",
       title.cex = 1.0,
       bty = "n")
dev.off()

# =========================
# Save legend only to PDF 
# =========================
pdf(out_legend_pdf, width = 2.5, height = 1.5)
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot.new()
legend("center",
       legend = c("Up-regulated Fusions", "Down-regulated Fusions"),
       col = c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5"),
       pch = 15,
       pt.cex = 1.2,
       cex = 0.9,
       title = "Fusion Expression",
       title.cex = 1.0,
       bty = "n")
dev.off()

message("\nPlots saved to:")
message("  Circos PNG: ", out_circos_png)
message("  Circos PDF: ", out_circos_pdf)
message("  Legend PNG: ", out_legend_png)
message("  Legend PDF: ", out_legend_pdf)

```
